title: fix(app-shell): marketplace cards give the title the header row and cut the id in the middle (objectui#12616)
body:
Fixes #12616
Clause-②: no

## What changes

The marketplace card header (`PackageCardHeader` in `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePage.tsx`, shared by the catalog card and the "Your organization" card):

- **The title takes the text column first**: 13px, semibold (600, from `CardTitle`), `line-clamp-2` with `break-words`, never `truncate`. The clamp is visual only; the DOM text is the whole name.
- **The badge sits on its own line under the title** (publisher badge on a catalog card, visibility badge on an org card), `self-start`, inside the text column. The header row holds only the icon and the text column, so nothing takes the title's width.
- **The id is 11px mono, one line, cut in the middle only when it does not fit.** It is drawn as two runs in one flex line: the head (up to and including the last `.`, `min-w-0 truncate`) shrinks and takes the ellipsis; the package suffix (`shrink-0 truncate`, capped at the column less 4ch) does not. `splitPackageSuffix` in `middleTruncate.ts` finds the split and never shortens anything: the element's text and its `title` are the whole id.
- **Every card grid is `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr))`** (catalog, "Your organization", loading placeholders), in place of `sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3`.

No change to marketplace data, the install flow, the card's click target or its test ids. Nothing is added to the `@object-ui/app-shell` entry: `PackageCardHeader` and `splitPackageSuffix` are module-local to the marketplace directory (the entry re-exports `MarketplacePage`, which takes no props), so `Clause-②: no` holds.

## Resumed work: what was inherited and what was kept

This branch was started by a dev whose session ran out of tokens (claim `6207618158`); the seat's takeover claim `6209672630` resumed it from `e9372154fa`. Every inherited commit was read hunk by hunk:

- `535696a` (the header and grid): **kept**, except the id. The title, badge and grid hunks meet the issue's Target. The id was cut by a fixed 20-character budget derived from the narrowest card, so every id longer than 20 characters was cut at **every** card width: HotCRM's real manifest id `app.objectstack.hotcrm` (22 characters) read `app.objectsta…hotcrm` on a card with room for the whole id. Replaced in `72d6611` by the CSS head/suffix runs above, which cut only when the id does not fit.
- `934020b` (tests): **kept and corrected.** The page-level pin (`MarketplacePage.cardHeader-12616.test.tsx`) mounts `MarketplacePage` itself against a stubbed runtime and asserts the header structure and the grid track for both cards; its id case now pins the two runs instead of the fixed-budget string. Its header quoted widths that no run re-reads and promised readings "quoted in the pull request" that did not exist; both are gone. The helper test now pins `splitPackageSuffix`.
- `e937215` (changeset): **kept, reworded** for the new id cut.
- `f4bb4b8`: merge of `origin/main` at `63d00da` (no conflicts, nothing on main touched this directory).

## Tests

All at head `72d6611`, run from the worktree root through the shared verify lock:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/` (the root form of `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`): `Test Files 1434 passed | 1 skipped (1435)`, `Tests 13581 passed | 9 skipped (13590)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- The two new files alone: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 11 passed (11)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (echoes `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists both new test files (1435 test files in the program).

**Ablation (one-shot, no permanent file; fix committed first, each leg restored with `git checkout HEAD --` and proven by HEAD-blob hash equality and an empty `git diff HEAD`):**

- `MarketplacePage.tsx` reverted to `origin/main` `63d00da` (the defect): the page-level pin goes `Tests 8 failed (8)`; all four cases fail for both cards (title class, badge placement, id runs, grid track).
- `MarketplacePage.tsx` and `middleTruncate.ts` reverted to the inherited tip `e9372154fa` (the fixed budget): `Tests 2 failed | 6 passed (8)`; exactly the id case fails for both cards (`expected 'app.objectsta…hotcrm' to be 'app.objectstack.hotcrm'`).

happy-dom does no layout, so the 240px half of the acceptance's test is pinned structurally (the track minimum, the title's clamp instead of a one-line cut, the badge off the title row). The rendered widths are the reading below.

## Layout reading (static Chromium harness, not the served console)

The DOM the page-level test renders was dumped from happy-dom once (the fixed tree, and the same tree with `MarketplacePage.tsx` at `63d00da`), compiled with the console's Tailwind entry (`tailwindcss` 4.3.3 plus `@object-ui/app-shell/styles.css`), loaded in the preinstalled Chromium with the grid in a box of a set width, and measured (`clientWidth`/`scrollWidth`, per-character rects for the visible text). One reading, not re-derived by anything; the page widths are harness choices, not the console's measured content widths.

| main | 1280, 960px | 309px | whole | `app.objectsta…` (end cut) | `com.northwind.custom…` |

The org fixture's 64-character name is clamped at two lines in the 240px card (DOM text whole) and drawn whole on two lines from 309px up. Its 27-character package name is the long-suffix edge: at 240px the suffix is capped (column less 4ch) and cut at its own end, keeping the head's first characters.

NOT MEASURED: screenshots, reason: the seat takes one shared browser reading for the resumed cards at review, before ACCEPT.

- No locale file changed, so the i18n gates (`check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`) are not owed. The rest of the `check:*` farm is CI's.
